notes: Completes feature coverage with revocation API, audit logging, and lifecycle tests.

stories.title: Token Revocation API and Admin Control
stories.description: Implement an internal API and admin control path to revoke active bearer tokens by token_id or agent scope. Revocation must immediately invalidate tokens and persist revocation_status with timestamp for audit and enforcement in validation flow.

stories.title: Token Lifecycle Audit Logging
stories.description: Extend existing audit logging to capture token lifecycle events including issuance, rotation, expiration enforcement, and revocation. Ensure logs include token_id, agent identity, timestamp, and action type without exposing raw token values.

stories.title: End-to-End Token Lifecycle Tests
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating full token lifecycle: creation, validation, expiration rejection, rotation correctness, and revocation enforcement. Include edge cases such as concurrent rotation and expired token reuse.
